newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Cyprus stocks end week 0.71pct lower on correction.
newsitem.headline: Cyprus stocks end week 0.71pct lower on correction.

text.p: Cyprus equities slipped 0.71 percent in the week ending July 4 as the market entered a period of consolidation after market rises in June, brokers said.
The Cyprus Stock Exchange (CSE) index, set at 100 points, closed the week at 76.27 points, from last week's close of 76.82.
"The market has started to enter a period of consolidation, and there is possibly a slight correction as well, after some steep rises over the past two weeks," one floor trader said.
Of the seven sub indices, five fell and two rose. The sub index of banking stocks closed at 84.54, a 0.47 percent drop from last week.

Bank of Cyprus shares dropped one cent, trading at 294.5 while shares in the Cyprus Popular Bank were two cents lower at 304.5. Fully paid shares in the Hellenic Bank retreated three cents, closing at 281.5.
Universal Life Savings Bank shares closed the week at 189.5, up one cent from 188.5 last Friday.
Stocks in the insurance sector shed 1.2 percent, with the sub index closing at 65.07 points.
Universal Life Insurance company stocks fell 10 cents to 461, Paneuropean was steady at 103.5 and Interamerican Insurance shares were trading at 95.5, up one cent.

After a rally on Cyprus Airways shares which forced a 24-hour suspension of their trading for exceeding a 15 percent volatility limit last week, shares settled at 33.9 cents on Friday, from 34.1 last week.

Blue chip cement stocks Vassiliko closed at 155, 2.5 cents down from last week. At a news conference on Thursday, board chairman Panos Ghalanos announced plans to issue a dividend of 4.5 cents per share for 1996 over 3.0 cents issued in 1995.

The company, which is 33 percent owned by the Italcementi group, posted pre-tax profits of 5.55 million pounds ($10.7 million) in 1996, a 9.8 percent rise from a year earlier. Turnover in 1996 reached 26.3 million, compared to 24.5 million in 1995.
Cyprus Cement retreated six cents to 238.5.
Beer and wine manufacturer KEO shares closed at 109.5 from 113 last week. ($=0.516 cents)
